name: Kumase narrow-strip foot-loom weaving
description: In Kumase, weavers used foot looms for narrow strips that could be sewn together into larger cloth, including cotton adinkra cloth.

date.label: 1817, observed during Bowdich’s Kumase visit
date.basis: Date of the scoped witness or archaeological context, not a claim of origin.

events.statement: Weaving was established in Kumase when Bowdich observed a foot loom in 1817; the scholar also describes narrow cotton strips sewn into adinkra cloth.

evidence.supports: The article describes woven cotton strips joined into cloth and dates Bowdich’s observation of Kumase foot-loom weaving to his 1817 visit.
